# Waiting time after the blood test

Mum finished the blood test in five minutes and waited forty for transport. She was hungry but wouldn't leave the collection point. The appointment system has no place for this waiting time. Pack food, yes, but also ask whether someone can text when the car leaves its previous stop. [[Care arrangements]] should not turn a predictable delay into another personal failure to prepare.
